comparison_unit: within task/fresh-state; raw fixes denoise/action-token/expert-ID, persistent rebound also requires the expert in all ten rounds
statistic: equal-stratum mean of sign(feature_i-feature_j) * sign(target_i-target_j); ties contribute zero

targets.total_x0_x10: RMS over the complete 10x7 live chunk of x0-x10
targets.immediate_xd_xd1: round d: RMS over the complete 10x7 live chunk of x[d+1]-x[d]
targets.remaining_xd_x10: round d: RMS over the complete 10x7 live chunk of x[d]-x[10]

features.weighted_rebound: for a persistent candidate/token/expert: w*raw at d9 minus its minimum over d0..d9

design_boundaries.fresh_state: init_state_id 24 is outside the earlier 16-state archive, but there is only one state per task
design_boundaries.power: K=16 and one state per task give low task-level replication power
design_boundaries.selection: raw comparisons condition on the same expert being selected in at least four candidates
design_boundaries.inference: no p-values, confidence intervals, or multiple-testing claims; the 3 x 10 x 2 per-round scan is descriptive

old_K32_total_displacement_baselines.interpretation: total flow displacement is strongly predictable without MoE; runtime incremental value must be tested beyond these baselines

old_K32_same_seed_other_state_residual.residual_definition: target minus the mean of the other 15 states at the same seed
old_K32_same_seed_other_state_residual.boundary: external K32 formal control supplied after this runtime pilot; it is not evidence that the K16 runtime capture replicated

verdict: The offline frozen directions retain the expected task-equal macro sign, but none reproduces its expected direction in all five fresh-state runtime tasks. This pilot is not a confirmation.
